compute_inception_score: compute the Inception Score for GAN-generated images using a pre-trained Inception v3 model
run_is_evaluation: run Inception Score evaluation on generated images with configurable number of splits
calculate_kl_divergence: calculate KL divergence between per-image class probabilities and their mean distribution
get_is_mean_std: get the mean and standard deviation of Inception Scores across multiple splits
evaluate_gan_quality: evaluate GAN image quality by computing Inception Score with a TorchScript Inception detector
